spans.s:
m. (-त्रः)
A step-mother's son.
f. (-त्री)
A step-mother's daughter.
E.
वि different, मातृ a mother, and अण् aff.

m. (-यः)
A step-mother's son.
f. (-यी)
A half sister, or one by a different mother.
E.
विमातृ a step-mother, and ढक् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Relating to a heavenly car, borne in one, &c.
E.
विमान, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Liberated, emancipated, being at liberty or loose.
n. (-क्तं)
Liberation.
E.
विमुक्त free, loose, and अण् aff. implying property or possession.

n. (-ख्यं)
1 Turning away the face.
2 Flight, retreat.
E.
विमुख, and ख्यञ् aff.

m. (-यः)
Barter, exchange.
E.
वि before मेङ् to barter, यत् aff., and अण् added.
